title: Voice Lab
objectives: Explain how the voice box works
Link vocal cord length to pitch

stages.title: The Stolen Voices
stages.narration: The Baron has muted every voice. Rediscover how sound is made to reclaim fragment 4!

steps.text: Nobody at the academy can speak or sing.
Anaya mouths words but no sound comes out.

stages.title: How Does Each Animal Make Sound?
stages.prompt: Match each sound-maker to how it produces sound.

tasks.label: A human speaking
tasks.explain: Vocal cords in the voice box vibrate.

tasks.label: A buzzing bee
tasks.explain: Its wings beat fast, making the buzz.

stages.title: High or Low Voice?
stages.prompt: Shorter vocal cords vibrate faster (higher). Predict each voice.

tasks.label: A child (short cords ~15 mm)
tasks.explain: Short cords vibrate faster → higher pitch.

tasks.label: An adult man (long cords ~20 mm)
tasks.explain: Longer cords vibrate slower → lower pitch.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Restore the Voices
stages.prompt: Score 80% to give the world its voice back and win fragment 4!

questions.q: The human voice comes from the…
options: vocal cords in the voice box
questions.explain: Vocal cords vibrate to make the voice.

questions.q: What makes the vocal cords vibrate?
questions.explain: Air passing between them makes them vibrate.
